mapper.select:
SELECT t.field_id AS id, t.field_code AS `code`, t.field_name AS `name`, case when t.field_data_type = 'Bigint' then 'Integer' else t.field_data_type end AS dataType, t.field_title AS title, t.is_show AS isShow, if(t.is_measure = 1, 1 ,t.is_filter) AS isFilter, if(t.is_measure = 1 and t.is_filter = 0 , 'double-range', t.filter_type) AS filterShowType, if(t.is_measure = 1 and t.is_filter = 0 ,'agg', t.filter_value_mode) as filterValueMode,
t.filter_tips as filterTips, t.is_result AS isResult, t.is_measure AS isMeasure, t.is_sensitive AS isSensitive, t.agg_type AS aggExpression, t.agg_type AS rawAggExpression, t.show_format AS showFormatExpression, t.field_weight AS weight, t.key_field_name AS fieldKeyName, t.key_field_data_type AS fieldKeyType, t.filter_table_id AS filterTableId, t.filter_table_name AS filterTableName, t.filter_sql AS filterSQL, t.sort_id AS showOrder, t.is_active AS isActive, t.field_desc AS remark, case when t.field_type = 'cross_model_measure' then '' else t.dim_table_id end as dimTableId, case when t.field_type = 'cross_model_measure' then '' else t.dim_table_name end as dimTableName, case when t.field_type = 'cross_model_measure' then '' else t.fct_table_id end as factTableId, case when t.field_type = 'cross_model_measure' then '' else t.fct_table_name end as factTableName, t.field_extend_list as fieldExtendList, t.exp_append_string as exportAppendString, t.sensitive_type as sensitiveDataType, t.can_col_dim as canColDim, auth.white_paper_code as dataAuthWhitePaperCode, auth.module_code as dataAuthModuleCode, auth.dim_code as dataAuthDimCode, auth.data_auth_mode as dataAuthMode, auth.is_apply as dataAuthIsApply, u.kpi_name as kpiName, case when t.is_measure = 1 then u.measure_code else u.dim_code_1 end as kpiNo, t.is_common_date as isCommonDate, t.date_granularity as dateGranularity, t.is_date_non_agg as isDateNonAgg, t.field_type as fieldType, t.calc_code_expression as calcCodeExpression, DATE_FORMAT(t.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime, DATE_FORMAT( t.updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS updatedTime, t.created_by as createdBy, t.updated_by as updatedBy FROM ssd_field_def t LEFT JOIN ssm_field_kpi_rel u on t.field_code = u.field_code left join ssd_field_auth_dim auth on (t.field_code = auth.field_code or t.field_code = auth.white_paper_code) inner join ssd_table_def tb on ( tb.is_active = 1 and ( (tb.table_id = t.dim_table_id or tb.table_id = t.fct_table_id) OR t.field_type = 'cross_model_measure' ) ) where 1=1 and t.is_active = 1

SELECT k1.`field_id` as fieldId, GROUP_CONCAT(k1.`ctg_id`) as ctgId FROM `ssm_field_ctg_rel` k1 INNER JOIN ssd_field_ctg k2 ON k1.`ctg_id` = k2.`ctg_id` AND k1.`ctg_type` = 'front' WHERE k1.`is_active` = 1 AND k2.is_active = 1 GROUP BY k1.field_id

SELECT t1.`field_code` AS fieldCode, t1.white_paper_code AS whitePaperCode, t1.`module_code` AS moduleCode, t1.`dim_code` AS dimCode, t2.module_name AS moduleName, t2.dim_name AS dimName, t1.data_auth_mode as authMode, t1.is_apply AS isApply FROM ssd_field_auth_dim t1 inner join bi_portal.sys_data_auth_cfg t2 on t1.module_code = t2.module_code and t1.dim_code = t2.dim_code and t2.is_active = 1

SELECT t.table_id as id, t.table_schema as tableSchema, t.table_owner as tableOwner, t.table_name as `name`, t.table_desc as tableDesc, t.is_fact_table as isFactTable, t.granularity, t.orig_table_name as origTableName, t.support_query_engines as supportQueryEngines, t.data_process_type as dataProcessType, t.data_update_time_field as dataUpdateTimeField, t.data_slice_cfg as dataSliceCfg, t.view_depend_tables as viewDependTables, t.is_active as isActive, DATE_FORMAT( t.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime, DATE_FORMAT( t.updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS updatedTime, t.created_by as createdBy, t.updated_by as updatedBy, ifnull(t.is_kpi_table,0) as isKpiTable FROM ssd_table_def t where 1=1 and t.is_active = 1
ORDER BY t.created_time desc
SELECT table_id as tableId, etl_job as etlJob FROM `ssd_table_etl_job`

SELECT t.ctg_id AS id, t.ctg_name AS name, t.parent_ctg_id AS parentId, t.sort_id AS showOrder, t.is_active AS isActive, t.oversized as oversized, t.ctg_desc as ctgDesc, t.etl_job as etlJob, t.is_module as isModule, t.rpt_dev_owner as rptDevOwner, t.biz_owner as bizOwner, t.data_dev_owner as dataDevOwner, t.data_date as dataDate, t.data_desc as dataDesc, t.ctg_type AS type, dataset.dataset_id as datasetId, t.is_test_ctg as isTestCtg, t.data_type as dataType FROM ssd_field_ctg t left join (SELECT ctg_id, GROUP_CONCAT(dataset_id) dataset_id FROM ssm_dataset_ctg_rel GROUP BY ctg_id) dataset on dataset.ctg_id = t.ctg_id WHERE 1=1 AND t.is_active = 1 ORDER BY parent_ctg_id, sort_id

SELECT field_id as fieldId, level_num as levelNum, level1_field_key_name AS level1FieldKeyName, level1_field_name as level1FieldName, level2_field_key_name AS level2FieldKeyName, level2_field_name as level2FieldName, level3_field_key_name AS level3FieldKeyName, level3_field_name as level3FieldName, level4_field_key_name AS level4FieldKeyName, level4_field_name as level4FieldName, level5_field_key_name AS level5FieldKeyName, level5_field_name AS level5FieldName, level1_field_id AS level1FieldId, level2_field_id AS level2FieldId, level3_field_id AS level3FieldId, level4_field_id AS level4FieldId, level5_field_id AS level5FieldId FROM ssd_field_hierarchy where is_active = 1

SELECT t.`rel_id` as id, t.`pri_table_id` as primaryTableId, t.`sub_table_id` as subTableId, pri.`table_name` as primaryTableName, sub.`table_name` as subTableName, t.`pri_join_field` as primaryFieldId, t.`sub_join_field` as subFieldId, t.`sub_join_field2` as subFieldId2, priField.field_name as primaryFieldName, subField.field_name as subFieldName, subField2.field_name as subFieldName2, t.`join_type` as joinExpression, t.`join_on_type` as joinOnType, t.`weight`, t.is_active AS isActive, DATE_FORMAT( t.created_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS createdTime, DATE_FORMAT( t.updated_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s' ) AS updatedTime, t.created_by AS createdBy, t.updated_by AS updatedBy FROM ssd_table_rel t INNER JOIN ssd_table_def pri ON t.`pri_table_id` = pri.`table_id` INNER JOIN ssd_table_def sub ON t.`sub_table_id` = sub.`table_id` inner join ssd_field_def priField on t.`pri_join_field` = priField.field_id inner join ssd_field_def subField on t.`sub_join_field` = subField.field_id left join ssd_field_def subField2 on t.`sub_join_field2` = subField2.field_id WHERE 1 = 1 and t.is_active = 1

SELECT t1.field_code AS code, t1.exclude_field_code AS excludeCode, t1.field_name AS name, t1.exclude_field_name AS excludeName, t1.exclude_ctg_id AS excludeCategoryId, t1.ctg_id AS categoryId FROM ssd_field_exclude t1 WHERE 1=1 AND t1.is_active = 1
SELECT t.field_code as fieldCode, t.field_value as fieldValue, t.field_value_sort_num as fieldValueSortNum FROM ssm_field_value_sort t order by t.field_code, t.field_value_sort_num
SELECT field_id AS fieldId, ctg_type AS ctgType, ctg_id AS ctgId, sort_id AS sortId FROM ssm_field_ctg_rel WHERE is_active = 1
SELECT field_id AS fieldId, field_code AS fieldCode, field_title AS fieldTitle FROM ssm_filter_cache_cfg WHERE is_active = 1
select sub_table_id as subTableId, pri_table_id as priTableId from ssm_table_pri_sub_cfg
select field_code as fieldCode, field_key as fieldKey, field_value as fieldValue from ssm_field_value_map

select db_name as dbName, table_name as tableName, field_name as fieldName, sensitive_level as sensitiveLevel, sensitive_ctg1_name as sensitiveCtg1Name, sensitive_ctg2_name as sensitiveCtg2Name, sensitive_ctg3_name as sensitiveCtg3Name from ssm_field_sensitive_level where 1=1

select t1.core_type as coreType, t1.field_title as fieldTitle, t1.field_type as fieldType, trim(t1.field_code) as fieldCode, t1.sensitive_level as sensitiveLevel from ssm_field_core t1 where t1.field_code is not null

select t1.core_type as coreType, t1.field_title as fieldTitle, t1.field_type as fieldType, trim(t1.field_code) as fieldCode, t1.sensitive_level as sensitiveLevel from ssm_olap_field_core t1 where t1.field_code is not null

SELECT dataset_id AS datasetId, dataset_name AS datasetName, rpt_dev_owner AS rptDevOwner, data_dev_owner AS dataDevOwner, data_date AS dataDate, data_desc AS dataDesc, sort_id AS sortId, is_active AS isActive, is_standard_dataset AS isStandardDataset, dataset_type AS datasetType FROM ssm_dataset WHERE is_active = 1
